schema: Audio-V Oracle origin candidate promotion policy v1

dataBoundaries.development: Model fitting and leave-one-source-group-out diagnostics only
dataBoundaries.calibration: Threshold selection only; zero false-hit source groups required
dataBoundaries.test: One-time held-out promotion decision; no threshold or feature tuning
dataBoundaries.challenge: Dataset-specific generalization and false-advisory veto across MAESTRO, MUSDB18-HQ, and EBU SQAM
dataBoundaries.edgeAbstention: All-negative veto across naturally narrow-band MUSAN speech, music, and noise

decisionRules: Every requirement must pass for each promoted detector.
Challenge positive-transform sensitivity is reported but cannot compensate for a challenge false advisory.
A failed gate rejects the candidate without changing Oracle production verdicts.
After opening held-out test results, feature definitions, model settings, and thresholds are frozen for that candidate version.
